scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend
scripts.dev: npm run clear && concurrently "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd backend && npm run dev"
scripts.demo:db:up: docker start odyssey-demo-db 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name odyssey-demo-db -p 5433:5432 -e POSTGRES_DB=odyssey_demo -e POSTGRES_USER=odyssey_demo -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=odyssey_demo -v odyssey-demo-db:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:13-alpine
scripts.demo:db:reset: docker rm -f odyssey-demo-db; docker volume rm odyssey-demo-db; npm run demo:db:up
scripts.demo:backend: cd backend && ENV_PATH=.env.demo npm run dev
scripts.demo:seed: cd backend && ENV_PATH=.env.demo node scripts/demo-seed/index.js && node ../demo/snapshot.mjs save
scripts.demo:catalog: cd frontend && UPDATE_DEMO_CATALOG=1 npx jest testing/lib/demo-catalog.test.ts
